item: The first All diagnostics run hands the files over: the numbered-files bar sits under the buttons that fill it, scrolls into view, and a set of one click is handed to the browser when the build ends
summary: The 2026-10-06 report (the full run did not work, 'again' was pressed): the ten bundles (eight machines) carry no error; in five of them the route counts show a build run to the end, split, nothing downloaded, then run again 27 to 116 minutes later. Reproduced in Chromium: the end of a build (9 to 48 minutes in these bundles) blanked the line beside the button and the Save button sat 300-500 px lower, off the screen at 1024x640. The bar now sits directly under the buttons that fill it (pinned by the exact button list), is scrolled into view when the pressed button is on screen, and a set that fits one click (five files; no split set in the reports was larger than two) is handed to the browser at the end of the build; a larger set waits for its button. Headless Chromium walked it at three window sizes; a headful browser's own several-downloads prompt is unverified. DEFAULT TAKEN, NOT YET RULED (OPEN_QUEUE). Lesson in LESSONS.md: A LONG BUILD ENDED IN SILENCE.
